title: The leap second is on the chopping block — and timekeeping could change forever - KSL
description: International timekeepers are on track to vote on eliminating what's known as a leap second — a tiny, but many say important, link between Earth's rotation and the world's time standard.

title: Jose Ramirez takes blame as miscues sink Guardians in Game 2 of ALCS vs. Rays - ESPN
description: Guardians star Jose Ramirez expressed regret for a pair of costly fourth-inning miscues that led to three unearned runs for the Rays, who evened the series with a 3-1 win in Game 2.

title: China’s exports surge 36% as AI-related shipments boom - Financial Times
description: Imports soar by a third as high oil prices from Middle East conflict push up energy bill
